import os

# Check for in-memory objects that might already hold the data
globals().keys()

# Search accessible filesystem for files whose NAME hints at invoice/supplier/ledger
hits = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk('/'):
    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in ('proc','sys','dev','usr','lib','lib64','bin','sbin','etc','var','opt','snap','boot','run')]
    for f in files:
        fl = f.lower()
        if any(k in fl for k in ('invoice','supplier','vendor','ledger','ap_','payable','schema','import')):
            hits.append(os.path.join(root, f))
hits
